absent: Exact capacities for command line storage, init argument bound and bootconfig payload ceiling.
Magic octet sequence and length plus checksum procedure for bootconfig trailer.
Internal steps of unpack to root filesystem beyond shared static state exclusion.
Creation, scheduling and teardown semantics for first process and thread daemon beyond ordering, sharing attributes and pinning.
Numeric thresholds behind debug, quiet and default console verbosity.
Textual rendering that turns bootconfig subtrees into supplemental command line fragments.
Lifetime and synchronization rules for override filesystem context beyond install and restore pairing.
Configured wrap ideal length and behavior when surplus tokens exceed transient buffer capacity.
Consumers and effects of late time hook, static key flag, early interrupt flag and full system state enumeration.
Failure modes for early allocation and string helpers beyond panic on exhaustion and fatal on malformed layout.

findings.text: Initramfs self test exposes a suite with a suite wide initializer plus per test setup that installs an override filesystem and stashes prior context and per test teardown that restores it, together with a table of nine named scenarios covering extraction and name handling and payload and checksum and hardlink and volume and padding and path ceiling and header digits, closed by an empty terminator.

Suite wide initialization must wait for asynchronous boot time population to complete before invoking unpack from the test thread, because unpack depends on module static mutable state that cannot tolerate concurrent writers.
Case table is laid out as a contiguous array of descriptors each associated with one test routine, with completion signalled by a final empty descriptor rather than a stored length.
Caps for init arguments and init environment entries both derive from one configured bound, with storage reserving two additional slots beyond each cap for termination and iteration safety.

Initial argument list holds a single entry naming the init program and initial environment holds home at filesystem root plus a console terminal type, each null terminated. Attempts to grow beyond caps latch a deferred fault naming the affected vector and the offending token and suppress further growth.

Parameter compatibility scan matches an input token against registered names by prefix, treats early marked entries as already consumed when followed by end or assignment while continuing to allow duplicate names, consumes and warns for entries without handlers, and otherwise offers the remainder to the registered handler with handler success consuming the token.

Early option handling copies the boot command line once into staging guarded by a completion flag, then offers each token to early marked handlers using parameter part equality, warns when a handler rejects its value, and accepts every token at this stage without filtering.

Bootconfig extraction from the ramdisk validates overall bounds and trailer size, tolerates up to three bytes of skew across four candidate positions when locating trailing magic, requires the preceding header to sit inside the ramdisk, enforces payload size against a global ceiling and against available extent, checks integrity, then shortens the ramdisk to exclude the payload and optionally reports its size, yielding absence on any failure.

Bootconfig setup always detaches any ramdisk trailer, prefers ramdisk payload with embedded payload as fallback, records the init argument offset discovered during command line inspection, proceeds only when requested on the command line or forced by configuration, parses with position diagnostics, reports loaded extent and node population, and renders separate kernel and init subtrees into supplemental command line and init arguments while skipping kernel rerender when embedded keys were already prepended.

Without bootconfig support, lookup always reports absence, setup only detaches any trailer, presence of the bootconfig token on the command line produces a missing support warning, teardown does nothing, and the found indicator plus init offset behave as constant false and zero.

Unrecognized boot tokens pass through ordered filters for sysctl aliases and bootloader identifiers and obsolete handlers and dotted module names, with survivors carrying values extending the environment with duplicate suppression and survivors without values extending init arguments, all subject to deferred fault on overflow and with separator restoration before classification.

Selection of the primary init path or the ramdisk init path records the supplied string, flags explicit ramdisk selection in the ramdisk case, and clears previously collected init arguments beyond the first slot to discard bootloader supplied defaults.

Command line construction places supplemental kernel keys before both saved and static views to preserve separator meaning, appends supplemental init keys to the saved view after a separator formed by blank plus two dashes plus blank while honoring a recorded offset when available, allocates both views from early memory, and records the saved view length.

Boot thread creates the first user process with shared address space and untraced creation, pins it to the boot processor with affinity change prohibited, installs default NUMA policy, creates the kernel thread daemon with shared filesystem and file table, publishes its handle, advances global state to scheduling, signals daemon readiness, then schedules once and enters the idle loop without returning.
Translation of freshly created process identifiers to task handles for pinning and publication is performed inside read side critical sections that are promptly released.

Growth beyond init argument or environment capacity latches a reason and parameter pointer that blocks later appends and suppresses unknown option reporting, while environment tokens whose separator layout matches neither plain nor quoted form are treated as fatal.

Several early platform hooks default to empty weak definitions intended for override, covering post ACPI bringup, processor identity, boot CPU preparation, CPU count setup, secondary CPU preparation, thread stack cache, live patching, page table cache, trap setup and initcall debug enable.

Verbosity controls select debug or quiet console thresholds, numeric level control updates the threshold only on valid numeric input and otherwise signals invalid argument, and a reset control sets a global device reset flag and reports consumption.
Stack offset randomization is switched by parsing a boolean token to enable or disable a static branch, with per CPU random state seeded once during early initialization.

Unknown option announcement is omitted when a deferred fault is pending or no surplus tokens exist, otherwise surplus init and environment tokens are joined with spaces into a transient buffer for a single notice that is then released. Command line announcement emits a single prefixed line when wrapping is disabled or ideal width exceeds capacity, otherwise it splits at spaces to respect ideal width with a continuation marker and prefixes each emitted line.

First process creation uses a descriptor carrying sharing flags plus entry point plus opaque argument, while daemon creation requests filesystem and file sharing. Both results are resolved from identifiers to task handles for subsequent pinning and publication.

Defaults and placement facts include ramdisk init path at root with single component naming init, boot command storage sized by line capacity and restricted to init phase, saved command pointer plus length frozen after init, early interrupt disabled flag plus system state plus static key flag held as mostly read, late time hook held as init data, and initial delay calibration set to two raised to twelve.

Initialization phase entry surface comprises command line setup, bootconfig setup and teardown, early parsing, the non returning rest of init trampoline, generic boot token and init argument handlers, primary and ramdisk init selectors, and verbosity and reset selectors.
Early NUMA initialization assigns each possible processor its early node mapping when per CPU node identity is in use and no direct translation macro exists.

Command line log prefix consists of the words Kernel, command and line followed by colon and blank, with continuation formed by blank plus backslash. Wrap ideal length derives from configuration clamped to a minimum covering prefix plus continuation, with derived ideals for line and split widths.
Bootloader tokens ignored during classification comprise a prefix denoting boot image and a token denoting kexec.
